propositions: Three filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) are defined in fsck_repair.py but are pure store utilities unrelated to repair logic, causing seven production modules to import from the wrong location.
The current dependency graph creates an inverted architectural relationship where command-layer repair module is imported by store-layer gitutil for filesystem metadata operations.

Moving the three primitives from fsck_repair.py to gitutil.py eliminates the inverted dependency while preserving backward-compatibility re-exports in fsck.py and fsck_repair.py for existing test monkeypatching.
The move must maintain gitutil.py as a stdlib-only leaf module with no module-level rebar.* imports, keeping _dir_is_archived's reducer dependency function-local.
Seven production consumer modules (fsck_scan, fsck, gitutil, fsck_recover, compact, bridge_repair, tracker_maintenance) must be repointed to import the primitives from gitutil instead of fsck_repair.
